scope: Independent nomenclatural check of the eight COL XR synonym proposals and the one source-family mismatch. This review does not test, re-identify, or replace any of the historical study specimens.

The Catalog of Fishes synonym chain supports Yarica hyalosoma, while NCBI Taxonomy presents Apogon hyalosoma as its current name and Yarica hyalosoma as a homotypic synonym. The genus placement remains unresolved across consulted sources.

familyConflict.catalogOfFishesTreatment: Valid as Zenarchopterus dispar in Zenarchopteridae.
familyConflict.interpretation: The 2014 article's family label differs from the current catalog placement. This is a classification update, not evidence that the field specimen was misidentified.

limitations: Taxonomy authorities address name usage and classification; they do not re-identify the organisms in Guzman and Capaque's historical study.
The COL XR crosswalk remains a proposal ledger. Source spellings, the 38-row table, three genus-only labels, dates, reach codes and study context remain unchanged.

Seven corroborated name proposals do not authorize a public checklist or current-presence claim; the source's historical rows still need a separate reach/date/coordinate projection review and rights/attribution check.
The Apogon hyalosoma genus conflict is held; neither Apogon nor Yarica is selected for publication by this review.
No feeding ecology, habitat, abundance, fishability, legal rule, safety or bait claim was inferred from taxonomy pages.
nextAction: Validate the Bugang article's four reach locations and station coordinates against the article text and licensed basemaps; decide separately whether a dated, historical reach-scoped evidence projection is supportable, retaining source names and holding Apogon hyalosoma pending resolution. Continue other Panay and Guimaras inland-water research in parallel.
